description: This file contains unit tests for the VA-API (Video Acceleration API) integration in Chromium, specifically testing the vaapi_wrapper and related VA-API functionalities such as profile support, surface allocation, and driver capabilities.

classes.name: VaapiTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for VA-API related tests.
